out_items.name: Adequate handwashing sinks properly supplied and accessible

violations.title: Handwashing Sink, Designated Use
violations.observation: Observed the handsink at the @LOCATION@ being used @OBSERVATION@. - OBSERVED: kitchen hand sink was used to store a spray bottle and wiping clothes.
violations.corrective_action: Handsinks are to be used only for washing hands to encourage proper hand washing and to prevent contamination of cleaned hands. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: a food employee removed the spray bottle and wiping clothes. BLUESTONE LANE (Inspection Date: 06/24/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: - OBSERVED: poached eggs were prepared one day prior to the inspection and stored in Avantco 2-door flat top cooler for use.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM. Poached eggs were discarded.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: - OBSERVED: pickled onion (36f) was prepared 2 days prior to the inspection and stored in 2-door prep cooler without date marking.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS prompted CFM to mark the food item properly.

out_items.name: Consumer advisory provided for raw and undercooked food

violations.title: Consumer Advisory for Raw/Undercooked Food, Disclosure
violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: POACHED EGGS AND FRIED EGGS.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: please add a disclosure for the abovementioned food items on the menu.

out_items.name: Wiping cloths properly used and stored

violations.title: Wiping Cloths Stored in Sanitizer Solution
violations.observation: Wet wiping cloths used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces were observed stored on the counter.
violations.corrective_action: Wet wiping cloths are to be used for wiping counters and other equipment surfaces and are to be held in a chemical sanitizer solution at the appropriate concentration between uses. - CORRECTIVE ACTIONS: EHS educated CFM and prompted CFM to store the wet wiping clothes in sanitizer solution.

violations.title: (2017) Non-Continuous Cooking Process
violations.observation: The following raw animal foods were not properly cooked using a non-continuous cooking process: OBSERVED A POACHED EGG WAS REHEATING AT 85F ON STOVE. CFM SHARED THAT THE POACHED EGGS WAS COOKED IN BOILING WATER FOR ABOUT 5 MINUTES AND COOKING TEMPERATURE RANGED FROM 85-90F. THE POACHED EGGS WERE COOLED IN ICE WATER AND STORED IN REACH IN A COLER.
violations.corrective_action: Raw animal foods that were cooked using a non-continuous cook process shall be subject to an initial heating process that is no longer than 60 minutes in duration; immediately, after initial heating, cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified for cooked time/temperature control for safety food; after cooling, held frozenor cold; prior to sale or service, cooked using a process that heats all parts of the food to a temperature and for a time as specified under 3-401.11A-C; Cooled according to the time and temperature parameters specified under 3-501.14A if not hot held, served immediately or held using time as a public health control. IMMEDIATELY STOP NON-CONTINUOUS COOKING PROCESS AND DISCARD THE POACHED EGGS.

violations.title: Cooling from 135F to 41F, No More than 6 Hours
violations.observation: The following cooked time/temperature control for safety food(s) are not being adequately cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours. PICKLED ONION (50F) AND QUINOA (43F) WERE STORED IN AVANTCO 2-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER OVERNIGHT.
violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety foods shall be cooled from 135F to 70F within two hours and to 41F within a total of six hours to prevent the growth of harmful bacteria. Foods that have been temperature abused are to be discarded. CFM DISCARDED THE FOOD ITEMS.

violations.title: RTE TCS Food Prepared On Site, Date Marking
violations.observation: The following refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety food that is prepared on site is not used or discarded within 24 hours of preparation and was not observed to be date marked: (1) QUINOA (43F) WAS PREPARED ON 12/30/2025 AND STORED IN AVANTCO 2-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER WITHOUT DATE MARKING. (2) PANCAKE MIX (41F) WAS PREPARED 2 DAYS PRIOR TO THE INSPECTION AND STORED IN AVANTCO 2-DOOR COOLER WITHOUT DATE MARKING.
violations.corrective_action: Refrigerated, ready-to-eat, time/temperature control for safety foods that are prepared on site and kept for more than 24 hours cannot have a shelf-life of more than 7 days, including the day of preparation. These food items must be marked with either the 'consume-by' date and/or 'preparation' date, color-coded labels, or another marking system/method that effectively indicates shelf-life that is clearly understood and properly used by the employees. CFM MARKED THE FOOD PROPERLY.

violations.observation: The following raw and/or undercooked foods are provided on the menu, menu board, table tent or brochure without proper disclosure: POACHED EGGS.
violations.corrective_action: The Consumer Advisory shall include a disclosure statement that includes a description of the animal-derived foods as raw/undercooked or identification of the animal-derived foods by asterisking (*) them to a footnote that states that the items are served raw or undercooked, or contain raw or undercooked ingredients. PLEASE UPDATE THE MENU ACCORDINGLY.

out_items.name: Food and non-food contact surfaces cleanable, properly designed, constructed, and used

violations.title: Equipment, Maintain in Good Repair/Condition
violations.observation: The following refrigeration unit is not operating properly and is unable to maintain cold food at or below 41F: OBSERVED AMBIENT TEMPERATURE OF AVANTCO 2-DOOR UPRIGHT COOLER AT 42F.
violations.corrective_action: Repair/adjust the unit so it is able to maintain foods at or below 41F. Do not use the unit to store time/temperature control for safety foods while it is not operating properly. PLEASE OBTAIN URGENT SERVICE FOR THE UNIT WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

out_items.name: Warewashing facilities installed, maintained and used; test strips

violations.title: Irreversible Registering Temperature Indicator for Heat Sanitization
violations.observation: No heat sensitive test strip OR DISHWASHER TESTER available to verify heat sanitization step of mechanical warewashing machine.
violations.corrective_action: In hot water mechanical warewashing operations, an irreversible registering temperature indicator shall be provided and readily accessible for measuring the utensil surface temperature.

violations.title: Backflow Prevention, Approved Device Provided
violations.observation: Observed the lack of an approved backflow prevention device on the water supply system. OBSERVED A CHEMICAL MIXING DISPENSER IS DIRECTLY CONNECTED DOWNSTREAM FROM A MOP SINK WITH AN ATMOSPHERIC BREAKER.
violations.corrective_action: A plumbing system shall be installed to preclude backflow of a solid, liquid, or gas contaminant into the water supply system at each point of use at the food establishment, including on a hose bib if a hose is attached or on a hose bib if a hose is not attached and backflow prevention is required by Law by installing an approved backflow prevention device as specified under 5-202.14. EHS SHARED THE INFORMATION OF APPROVED SPLITTER WITH CFM. CFM WILL NEED TO INSTALL AN APPROVED SPLITTER ON THE MOP SINK. BLUESTONE LANE (Inspection Date: 01/02/2026) Page 2 of 3

violations.title: Air Gaps/Breaks
violations.observation: An air gap between the water supply outlet and the flood rim level AT 3-COMPARTMENT SINK is not observed.
violations.corrective_action: An air gap between the water supply inlet and the flood level rim of the plumbing fixture, equipment, or nonfood equipment shall be at least twice the diameter of the water supply inlet and may not be less than one inch. PLEASE CREATE AIR GAPS FOR THE 3 BASINS OF THE 3-COMPARTMENT SINK.

violations.title: Food Thermometers, Provided & Accessible
violations.observation: The certified food manager could not provide a food temperature measuring device. THERE IS NO FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE.
violations.corrective_action: A metal-stemmed probe food thermometer shall be provided and readily accessible for use in ensuring attainment and maintenance of food temperatures. PLEASE OBTAIN A FOOD TEMPERATURE MEASURING DEVICE WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Hair Restraints
violations.observation: Employees observed working in the food service area without proper hair restraints.
violations.corrective_action: Food employees shall wear hair restraints such as hats, visors, hair nets or beard nets to effectively keep their hair from contacting exposed food, clean equipment, utensils, linens, and unwrapped single-service items. This section does not apply to food employees such as counter staff who ONLY serve beverages and wrapped or packaged foods, hostesses, and wait staff. EHS PROMPTED THE FOOD EMPLOYEES TO PUT ON HAIR RESTRAINTS.

violations.corrective_action: Obtain a QUATERNARY AMMONIA test kit WITHIN 10 CALENDAR DAYS.

violations.title: Cold Holding

violations.corrective_action: Time/temperature control for safety food shall be held cold at a temperature of 41F or below unless the permit holder is using 'time as public health control as specified under section 3-501.19 to limit bacteria growth. Food was discarded. Temperatures were not being held on the bottom portion of the u it due to poor ventilation.
